title: Apple MacBook Pro 16" with M4 Max Chip, 1TB SSD, 36GB RAM (Space Black) $4,559 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in Limited Stores) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: Apple MacBook Pro 16" with M4 Max Chip, 1TB SSD, 36GB RAM (Space Black) $4,559 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in Limited Stores) @ JB Hi-Fi

[sssssam] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/968726
3500 not long ago
[squattington] These price hikes are insanity… Totally killed my interest in buying a Macbook Pro
[ozbargainhunter400] Agreed but at the same time the whole market is cooked.
[gviddy] Agreed. Going forward only buying refurb items will be the way to go.
[Spector1] refurb got a price hike too but not by too much
[BargainBogan99] Literally last week (2024 version though?)
[Iamacheapo] @BargainBogan99: This one (black) was the same price last week. Silver was on clearance for 3599
[poppingtags] Such a shame…the M3 Max 16 with 48GB of RAM dropped to as low as $3300. A lot harder to find this generation that low. Might just hold out for the next generation update, it’s meant to be a complete redesign as well.
[Momoni] M6 is rumoured to have a short stint before the M7 comes out. If anything, I’ll wait for that. Personally, I will wait for M8.
[AustriaBargain] It has crazy processing power, crazy graphics power, a world class mini LED display, carved out of a solid block of aluminium, three thunderbolt ports and a dedicated power port and HDMI, sd card reader. It's probably the best laptop in the world, and it's certainly cheaper and has a better battery life than any PC equivalent.
[elektron] No OLED st this price point? Crazy. My Lenovo Chromebook that's 10 tines cheaper has one.
[AustriaBargain] Tandem OLED wasn't ready when the M1 Pro/Max launched.
[beesider] Why do you need OLED? It has a fantastic screen. OLED causes eye strain, this one doesn't. My former OLED Lenovo literally made me cry after 30 minutes of using it. With the MacBook I can use it for hours with no eye strain at all.
[dottjt] I actually wonder if these price hikes are actually in preparation for the new line up and their improvements. Like, it would look bad on Apple if they price hiked those to cover their costs, so they're just doing it now to soften the blow on that.
[poppingtags] Its due to RAM and component costs going through the roof thanks to all the AI companies buying up multiple years worth of production. We just have to wait till the bubble pops.
[gviddy] It is due to greed. These computers would have been built long ago and are sitting in warehouses. Yes all their future laptops will be expensive but increasing the price of current stock is greed.
[poppingtags] I agree its due to greed, but JB haven't increased the price of current stock - different colour ways were discounted at different rates reflecting demand and stock levels. I definitely did see price gouging on eBay - the 48GB models had dropped to $4000 prior to Apple's price rise on the M5 Max, you can't find it at that price anymore.
[rhyme324] Got the silver one from last deal $3599.
But for $4559, I’d rather get 16’ m5 pro 18c from Apple refurbished store for $4079 if they have stocks.
Combined with woolies/coles gift cards deal and cashback. Less rams and gpu, but way better cpu and faster ssd.
[Davie-1] Depends what you want to play.
Tom’s guide did some benchmarking to see how it runs cyberpunk, and it’s playable.
But you could spend less than $4500 on a desktop build and you’d get significantly better performance and graphics than on any laptop.
https://www.tomsguide.com/gaming/we-benchmarked-cyberpunk-20…
[shabaka] still rocking my M1 Max MBP 16 with 2TB and 64GB.. sure this will be quite a bit faster, but the drop in RAM while paying this much for an upgrade is insane..
[nubix] Have the same one, ironically I wish it had died earlier so I could justify the upgrade before the price bumps :/ Maybe I'll have to end up getting a battery replacement.
[sidespyder] Our work fleet is M1 max 64gb
Really hoping they just refresh them all soon
[shabaka] I got a battery off Amazon for a $100. replaced it myself. it's like a bit of surgery lol.
I used to repair laptops so handling tiny screws of 5 different kinds and dissolving glue strips by soaking it in you know what felt familiar
but I tell you I wasn't whistling while I was doing it, and it took a good hour
[lunchbox99] I got a 128GB M5 Max 18/40c with 2TB for $6800. Now costs about $11k!!
Yes all for local LLMs.
[lunchbox99] I really wanted it in a studio, but had to settle for a 16" MBP cause I knew the ram price rise was coming before the m5 max studio - and they limit the m4 max or m3 ultra studio to 96GB now. Previously you could get the ultra studio with 512GB.
3 weeks after I got it, the price jumped to $11k overnight.
[bestd] https://www.amazon.com.au/Apple-MacBook-16-inch-18-core-40-c…
[bargaino] @fm1984: Depends. Do you have a spare $10,000 ?
I chose the options, got $10,299, but when you try "add to bag" its a 404.
[fm1984] @bargaino: it was just curious - if i need 128gb i will buy AMD Ryzen™ AI Halo instead.
I have M1 Max with 32gb RAM - I am looking to upgrade I thought this deal this good but when I looked at the one which was for 3500AUD a couple of weeks ago. I am not sure if I want to buy now .. I hope I can get that 3500AUD deal agian.
I dont run LLM on Mac but I run many CLI and do some devleopemnt stuff
[nmk] @fm1984: I am also evaluating this or Mac but still haven't decided
https://www.asus.com/au/laptops/for-creators/proart/proart-g…
[lunchbox99] @fm1984: Ryzen Halo is only 250GB/s memory bandwidth. M5 Max is 650GB/s. The Ultra version like the M3 Ultra is 820GB/sec.
Memory bandwidth matters for local AI.
[RNDM] Nice. I can't remember what made me decide not to buy one, but in hindsight, that looks really cheap compared to what they cost now.
[Cheepcheepcheep] What is your use case for LLMs just curious?
[lunchbox99] Mostly coding, but also playing with agents for a range of stuff. I have used about $5k worth of tokens already (if you bought it on a cloud service) and I reckon they will keep jacking API/MCP token prices well above what we pay now.
I also like running uncensored models without all the stupid guardrails for general AI queries. Lots of cloud models will give your BS instead of answering properly/fully.
[gviddy] What is your electricity bill? At times I think also I would like to use local LLMs but it is heaps cheaper to use cloud because electricity is so expensive locally.
[lunchbox99] I have used 2.5 billion tokens so far on my full stack web app project in about 4weeks (using it outside work hours). At full tilt its 130W max.
Estimated cost to buy that many tokens on a cloud service with the same model would be at least $5k.
[shabaka] What do you run? I have a 64gb and I am very much satisfied with everything that comfortably fits in 64
[lunchbox99] It's not the just the model - its running agents and large context. Some tasks can spawn multiple subagents - like in claude code plan mode.
I usually use qwen 3.6 27B with 262k context using claude code (local only) and claude-os. Sometimes hermes too.
I've built a fairly large full stack web app with it. Estimated at least $5k to purchase tokens with the same model on a cloud host.
[lordezekiel] Think i'll stick with 2011 MacBook Pro for now.
[dontpanic] I'm still doing fine with my M1 Max 64GB… with prices where they are I have no desire to upgrade.
[utsc] What is Apple Intelligence ? Is Apple running a LLM model locally in an Apple device :)
Built For Apple Intelligence — Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no-one else can access your data
